changelog: - **Choosing changes in a review can take the timetables, the step length and the kinds.** In a proposal review, “Choose changes” has three new lines: Kinds (with their units), Step length and Timetables. Each is taken whole or kept. A line you did not change yourself is pre-selected; one both sides changed differently is marked and left for you to decide. The “Run phases” line is pre-selected only when the timetables and the step length it was written for come with it. Under the lines, before the Apply, the review now says what a selection would do besides what its lines say. A value in a unit that would be read another way is refused: a hopper written as 0.9 bag, taken without the kinds table that declares the bag, used to become 0.9 kg with nothing to show it. A selection that would stop the run, such as a line that reads a timetable only the proposal holds, is told with the line that resolves it, and still applies. A line or a rule that would read the other side’s version of a timetable is told with what the table plans in each version and the first step at which they differ, whether you took the lines and kept your tables or took the tables and kept your lines. Applying the whole proposal takes what it took before; timetables, a step length or kinds that you changed differently now count as a conflict in what it asks first. Project revision files declare `loop-revision/14`; no file’s content or digest changes, and an earlier version of the app reads them as before.
